verdict.rationale: PostHog has a documented public API (posthog.com/docs/api.md, HTTP capture from any language), a live OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe (openapi.json), an official CLI for terminal/CI/CD use, and a documented MCP server enabling AI agents to run queries, ship flags, and inspect stack traces via plain text — all first-party documented and probe-verified. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the API/OpenAPI usage beyond vendor docs and probes.
